title: Inventory Dashboard
subtitle: Real-time Analytics & Reporting
description: Advanced inventory analytics dashboard with real-time tracking and reporting. Built to give warehouse managers and executives instant visibility across the entire supply chain — from stock levels to reorder alerts, purchase trends to supplier performance.
longDescription: This enterprise-grade inventory management dashboard was designed to solve a critical pain point: decision-makers waiting hours for static reports. The solution delivers live data streams visualized through an intuitive, dark-themed interface. Features include multi-warehouse tracking, automated low-stock alerts, historical trend analysis, and one-click executive summaries. Integrated with existing ERP infrastructure for zero data silos.
challenge: Legacy reporting system took 4+ hours to generate weekly reports. Stakeholders lacked real-time visibility into stock movements.
solution: Designed a streaming dashboard pipeline using Python ETL + SQL data warehouse + Power BI frontend with 15-minute refresh intervals.
impact: Reduced reporting lag from 4 hours to 15 minutes. Prevented 3 critical stockouts in the first quarter.

title: HRM System
subtitle: Complete HR Automation Platform
description: Complete employee management and HR automation platform. A fully integrated human resources management system handling everything from onboarding to payroll, performance reviews to leave management — built for a 500+ employee organization.
longDescription: Deployed a comprehensive HRM system that unified previously fragmented HR processes across five departments. The platform covers the full employee lifecycle: recruitment, onboarding, contract management, attendance, payroll computation, performance evaluation, and offboarding. Custom workflows automate approval chains, reducing HR overhead by 60%.
challenge: HR team managing 500+ employees across 5 departments using Excel spreadsheets and manual processes. Data inconsistencies and compliance risks.
solution: Implemented Odoo HRM with custom Python modules for local compliance requirements. Integrated biometric attendance hardware with automated payroll calculation.
impact: Reduced HR administrative workload by 60%. Achieved 100% payroll accuracy. Full audit trail for compliance.

title: Attendance System
subtitle: Smart Biometric Monitoring
description: Smart biometric and attendance monitoring solution with analytics. A hybrid system combining hardware biometric devices with cloud-based attendance management, delivering real-time workforce presence data to managers across multiple locations.
longDescription: Engineered an end-to-end attendance management solution that bridges physical biometric hardware (fingerprint + face recognition) with a centralized cloud dashboard. The system handles multi-site deployments, shift management, overtime calculation, late-arrival alerts, and monthly attendance reports. A mobile-responsive admin panel lets supervisors check team attendance from anywhere.
challenge: Manual attendance registers at 8 office locations creating payroll discrepancies and no real-time visibility into workforce presence.
solution: Deployed ZKTeco biometric devices at all sites, built custom Python sync service, and created centralized dashboard with location-wise analytics.
impact: Eliminated attendance fraud. Saved 20+ hours/month in manual data entry. Real-time visibility across all 8 locations.
